text:
- **Engine features by runner:** the two runners build the same test file against different engine features: `cargo test --workspace --locked` (CI's test leg, `ci-leg.sh fast`) resolves the whole workspace, where `blitz`'s default `tracing` feature turns on `blitz-shell/tracing` and `blitz-html/tracing` and each of those `blitz-dom/tracing`, so blitz-dom is built for that invocation with its `tracing` call sites compiled in — for blitz-tests, as the event below shows, and by the same resolved graph for the seven_guis binaries the invocation builds (read from the graph, not on a binary); `cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked` (what `agent-run.sh run` and a per-file gate run) and a `-p seven_guis` build leave it off (packages/blitz/Cargo.toml:14; packages/blitz/Cargo.toml:18; packages/blitz-shell/Cargo.toml:21; packages/blitz-html/Cargo.toml:15; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/evidence/feature-unification.md, from cargo's resolved feature graph). Under the workspace build the engine logs one INFO event beside a driver `type`, which escher's sink prints as `INFO blitz_dom::document … message=[redacted]`: the same check file read green under `-p blitz-tests` and red under the workspace leg, so a check that reads a sink's capture counts lines by target, never in total, and a green per-package run is not the workspace leg's green (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md).
 Measured at 2026-10-10-driver-cli for the session host: on a snapshot · click · type flow the workspace-built `escher-session` host prints one engine line, `blitz_dom::document` at INFO, from `info` up and no further line at `debug` or `trace`, the host built alone prints none, and `host_log` is green under both builds (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/evidence/by-level.md); re-read at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep, the workspace-built host prints that `focussed node` line twice (6 lines / 978 B, the `mcp` role 11 lines) and the host built alone none beyond its own (4 / 742 B, the `mcp` role 9), `host_log` and `mcp_log` green under both builds (escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/evidence/log-counts.md). Measured since 2026-10-14-quality-gates: the windowed `seven_guis_native` built with the workspace, read by level on the host's display (`wayland-1`), beside a client's own stderr and the host on flows beyond the three CRUD commands — 28 runs over both builds, 0 needles (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-quality-gates/evidence/stderr-by-level.md), and a recording session's clients' own stderr at `trace` is read by a standing check, `host_log`'s third test, green under the `-p seven_guis` and the workspace build (examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:42-132), and `host_log`'s fourth test reads a paged part through the host's own sink — `serve cells` at `RUST_LOG=trace`, a sentinel committed into a part-2 cell, then `snapshot --part 2` — 0 id and 0 name needles under both builds (examples/seven_guis/tests/host_log.rs:134-277); its earlier by-level readings were of a `-p seven_guis` build.
 Since the 2026-10-10 upstream merge the two runners differ in a second engine feature: the workspace build resolves blitz-dom with 16 features and the per-package build with 10, `writing-mode` on in the first only, and `writing-mode` selects which of two bodies of the engine's bounds reader `BaseDocument::physical_unrounded_geometry` is compiled — `visible_region` and every snapshot `bounds` read through it — so the same stand check runs over a different reader under each runner; `scroll_into_view_nested` (7), `stand_act_scroll` (6 since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, was 4) and `stand_act_obstructed` (5, was 3) pass under both, and since 2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit each of the reader's two bodies holds a check of ours — `scrolled_box_client_rect` (6), read under the per-package build and under the workspace build, its two mutation controls each red under its own build only — with `hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box` (9) and `scrolled_box_absolute_position` (1) green under both (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/writing_mode.rs:371-412; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2477-2504; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-upstream-sync-agent-surfaces/evidence/features.md, from cargo's resolved feature graph, the checks of both bodies at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/evidence/controls.md).
 Since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot blitz-test-harness depends on blitz-paint with `default-features = false`, so a per-package build of the harness paints no `svg` and no overlay scrollbars (the workspace build's features for it not read); `stand_screenshot_repeat` reads byte-identical shots under the per-package and the workspace build on one host — the shot's bytes differ across OSes (CI#39225375577, macOS aarch64 against linux x86_64) —, and the overlay scrollbar fade reads the document's clock — a harness document's the harness's `VirtualClock` — so a shot after a scroll repeats until `advance` moves the fade, read by `stand_virtual_clock` across an 800 ms sleep (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (packages/blitz-test-harness/Cargo.toml:24-28; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_virtual_clock.rs:50-96; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md)
